"""Camera/proprioception-only controller for the single stacking_wood episode.
Interactive JSON commands are recorded in commands.jsonl; every executed chunk is saved.
"""
import sys, json, pathlib, time, traceback
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/output'); OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))
last=None; count=0

def save(res):
    global last,count
    last=res; count+=1
    res.save(str(OUT/'runs'/f'{count:04d}'))
    d=OUT/'latest'; d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for i,(cam,a) in enumerate(res.last.items()):
        Image.fromarray(a).resize((672,672)).save(d/f'{i}.png')
        np.save(d/f'{i}_rgb.npy',a)
        if cam in res.last_depth: np.save(d/f'{i}_depth.npy',res.last_depth[cam])
    (d/'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta,indent=2))
    p=dict(zip(res.meta['proprio']['layout'],res.meta['proprio']['now']))
    (d/'proprio.json').write_text(json.dumps(p,indent=2))
    print(json.dumps({'run':count,'done':res.done,'reason':res.meta.get('reason'),'plan':res.meta.get('plan'),'clipped':res.meta.get('clipped'),'time_left_s':res.meta.get('time_left_s'),'base':{k:v for k,v in p.items() if 'base' in k},'eef':{k:v for k,v in p.items() if 'eef' in k},'gripper':{k:v for k,v in p.items() if 'gripper' in k}}),flush=True)

def current(): return dict(zip(last.meta['proprio']['layout'],last.meta['proprio']['now']))
def jointrow():
    p=current(); names=spec['action_types']['joint_position']['layout']; return np.array([0 if 'base' in n else p[n] for n in names],float)

def operate(c):
    if c['op']=='obs': save(r.get_obs(depth=True,seconds=c.get('seconds',0)))
    elif c['op']=='status': print(json.dumps(r.status()),flush=True)
    elif c['op']=='joint':
        a=jointrow(); names=spec['action_types']['joint_position']['layout']
        for k,v in c.get('set',{}).items(): a[names.index(k)]=v
        if 'base' in c: a[:3]=c['base']
        if 'left_grip' in c: a[14:16]=c['left_grip']
        if 'right_grip' in c: a[23:25]=c['right_grip']
        n=c.get('steps',30); dt=c.get('dt',1/30)
        save(r.submit('joint_position',np.tile(a,(n,1)),dt=dt,depth=True,video='both',note=c.get('note','')))
    elif c['op']=='ee':
        p=current(); poses=[]
        for side in ['left','right']:
            keys=[f'{side}_eef_{x}' for x in ['x','y','z','qx','qy','qz','qw']]
            poses+=c.get(side,[p[k] for k in keys])+[c.get(side+'_grip',1)]
        save(r.submit('ee_pose',[poses],depth=True,video='both',note=c.get('note','')))
    elif c['op']=='submit': save(r.submit(c['type'],c['actions'],dt=c.get('dt',1/30),depth=True,video='both',note=c.get('note','')))
    elif c['op']=='ik':
        p=current(); q=[p[n] for n in spec['kinematics']['joint_names']]
        bp=last.group('base_pose',now=True).tolist()
        sol=r.ik(c['targets'],seed=q,base_pose=bp,max_iters=c.get('max_iters',200),tol_pos_m=c.get('tol_pos_m',0.01),tol_rot_rad=c.get('tol_rot_rad',0.1))
        (OUT/'ik.json').write_text(json.dumps(sol,indent=2)); print(json.dumps(sol),flush=True)
        if c.get('execute') and sol.get('ok'):
            a=jointrow(); names=spec['action_types']['joint_position']['layout']
            for k,v in zip(spec['kinematics']['joint_names'],sol['q']):a[names.index(k)]=v
            if 'left_grip' in c:a[14:16]=c['left_grip']
            if 'right_grip' in c:a[23:25]=c['right_grip']
            save(r.submit('joint_position',np.tile(a,(c.get('steps',60),1)),dt=1/30,depth=True,video='both',note=c.get('note','')))
    elif c['op']=='fk':
        p=current(); print(json.dumps(r.fk([p[n] for n in spec['kinematics']['joint_names']],base_pose=last.group('base_pose',now=True).tolist())),flush=True)
    else: raise ValueError(c)

save(r.get_obs(depth=True))
print('READY',flush=True)
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        c=json.loads(line)
        with (OUT/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(c)+'\n')
        operate(c)
    except EpisodeOver as e:
        print('EPISODE_OVER '+str(e),flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print('ERROR '+str(e),flush=True); traceback.print_exc()
        if 'Connection' in type(e).__name__ or '5' == str(e)[:1]:
            print('RECOVERY '+json.dumps(r.wait_ready()),flush=True)
            print('STATUS '+json.dumps(r.status()),flush=True)
